objective: Bring 6 Elixirs of Lion's Strength and 2 Elixirs of Minor Defense to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.

description: Our herb and alchemy shop is booming, but my husband spends so much time mixing potions that we never have time for each other.
If you can bring me a supply of pre-made elixirs, then I would be happy to trade with you.  I have some rare herbs that you might find useful.
progress: Hello, <name>. Do you have the elixirs to trade?
completion: These are nicely mixed. You take great care in your trade, <name>, and that is important for an alchemist.
Here are your herbs, freshly gathered. May you use them well.
